sys_equipment CONSUMES money_gp runs opposite to canonical money_gp CONSTRAINS sys_equipment. DEC-2026-0011 does not settle this shape mechanically: the Reviewer decides case by case with both sources in hand. Carried unchanged.

enc_encumbrance CONSTRAINS sys_equipment runs opposite to canonical sys_equipment FEEDS_INTO enc_encumbrance; sys_equipment EXCLUDED_FROM enc_encumbrance. DEC-2026-0011 does not settle this shape mechanically: the Reviewer decides case by case with both sources in hand. Carried unchanged.
